The patch management procedure (LSPG) is fully documented and aligned with the standard's requirements, including the tracking, evaluation, and installation processes, as well as the mitigation plan management and the delegation of responsibilities. The procedure covers all the key elements of CIP-007-6 R2 Part 2.1 through Part 2.4, including the 35-day evaluation window, the applicability assessment, the actions to take (install, mitigate, or revise), and the implementation of mitigation plans. The operator's note on the 30-day evaluation window is a separate operational decision and does not affect the alignment of the procedure with the standard.
